parameters.query:
SELECT
  max(CASE WHEN key = 'llm_provider'          THEN value END) AS provider,
  max(CASE WHEN key = 'llm_model'             THEN value END) AS model,
  max(CASE WHEN key = 'llm_base_url'          THEN value END) AS base_url,
  max(CASE WHEN key = 'llm_cache_enabled'     THEN value END) AS cache_enabled,
  max(CASE WHEN key = 'llm_max_output_tokens' THEN value END) AS max_output_tokens
FROM app_settings;

SELECT response, tokens_in, tokens_out
FROM llm_cache
WHERE hash = md5($1 || '|' || $2 || '|' || $3 || '|' || $4)
LIMIT 1;

-- A truncated answer must not be cached. Caching it once would hand the same
-- half sentence back to every caller from then on.
INSERT INTO llm_cache (hash, provider, model, response, tokens_in, tokens_out)
SELECT md5($1 || '|' || $2 || '|' || $3 || '|' || $4), $1, $2, $5, $6::int, $7::int
WHERE $8::boolean IS NOT TRUE
ON CONFLICT (hash) DO NOTHING;

-- Cost is looked up from llm_pricing rather than hardcoded, so prices
-- can be updated as providers change them. NULL means we have no price
-- on file, which is more honest than recording zero.
INSERT INTO llm_usage
  (item_id, workflow, provider, model, tokens_in, tokens_out,
   estimated_cost_eur, duration_ms, cached, truncated)
VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3, $4, $5::int, $6::int,
  (SELECT ($5::numeric / 1000.0) * input_eur_per_1k
        + ($6::numeric / 1000.0) * output_eur_per_1k
     FROM llm_pricing WHERE provider = $3 AND model = $4),
  $7::int, $8::boolean, $9::boolean)
RETURNING id, estimated_cost_eur;
